Method of Attack: Spyware-like behavior including setting up an Android service and broadcast receiver
Collecting user's last known geo-location coordinates
Listening to incoming SMS messages containing specific command strings ('vova-' or 'get faq')
Responding to SMS commands to report location and change device password
Attack Vector: Malicious Android app distributed via Google Play Store
Indicators of Compromise: App named 'System Update' with blank white screenshots and minimal description
SMS commands prefixed with 'vova-' or containing 'get faq'
Similarity in code structure to DroidJack RAT
